gold.label: Gold
gold.nature: Monetary metal — industrial use is only about 5% of demand, so gold is priced almost entirely by macro.

favouring.label: CPI inflation
favouring.why: Metals are bought as an inflation hedge. CPI at 3.5% sits well above the 2% target, which supports that case.

pressuring.label: 10-year REAL yield
pressuring.why: Precious metals pay no income, so the real yield IS the cost of holding them. At 2.39% real (10Y 4.67% minus 2.28% breakeven inflation) that cost is high.

pressuring.label: US dollar (DXY)
pressuring.why: Metals are priced in dollars, so a firmer dollar mechanically pressures them. DXY 101.45, up on the week, up versus its moving averages.

pressuring.label: Gold speculative positioning
pressuring.why: Futures net length is 48.7% of open interest, -3.5 points on the week. Positioning does not cause the move; it shows how crowded the trade already is. Heavy length means a thin cushion, washed-out length means room to run.
